tonight.headline: Jacobs is out of the lineup — Marks went in where Gordon should
body: Bad news first: Bloodsports are 2-7. Jacobs is out after finger surgery, Gordon now runs behind Kyle McCord, Wilson and Pickens are both questionable, Loveland is on bye — three of five bench seats are dead this week. And the Rams D/ST claim this morning spent IPADE priority, which never resets, on a defence whose bye is next week.
ESPN: 126.3 to 111.6, 58%, against a 9-0 team. Two small things before Thursday: Gordon for Marks at FLEX (1.8, the projection's call) and Zvada for Gay (2.4, free agent).

case.label: Their side
case.body: Maye-day start Luther Burden III and the Bears D/ST, and Chicago are on bye (SI) — two zeroes unless they notice.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: McCarthy out before Thursday 19:15 (Likely) or Mahomes ruled out (Rice) — neither has a bench answer that projects higher.

doFirst.title: Start Gordon at FLEX, bench Marks
doFirst.subtitle: The projection's FLEX by 1.8 — a coin flip, so it goes to the projection and carries no thesis.

case.label: The call
case.body: Gordon 15.8, Marks 14.0 (lineup_check.py: COIN FLIP). Marks went in for Jacobs at 05:28 CDMX; the projection prefers Gordon.

case.label: What research adds
case.body: Gordon gets a new quarterback — Kyle McCord, with Willis on IR since Tuesday — and still had 94% of Miami's carries in Week 9. Marks' risk is Montgomery, whom Ryans hopes practises 'this week, or next' (FF 9 Nov). Neither is unpriced news.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Marks outscores Gordon in Week 10 (archive). No decision-log entry: coin flip.

doFirst.title: Add Dominic Zvada, drop Matt Gay
doFirst.subtitle: Free agent — no priority spent. The swap last night's brief said to make once he cleared unclaimed.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Zvada 10.7, Gay 8.3: 2.4 points, the biggest kicker gap on either roster. Zvada is a FREEAGENT in IPADE this morning, so the add costs nothing that lasts.

case.label: The kicker
case.body: Giants rookie; missed three field goals in the Week 5 overtime tie with Washington (FantasyNerds 11 Oct) — the same opponent Thursday. That miss rate is the honest risk.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Gay, 55% rostered — disagreeing with the market on the record: K17 this week and no item found on him. Las Vegas' bye is Week 13; Gay offers nothing Zvada does not.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gay outscores Zvada in Week 10 (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Jacobs came out — but Marks, not Gordon, went in
whatWentWrong.lead: Fixed at 05:28 CDMX: Jacobs to the bench. The FLEX took Marks (14.0) where the projection has Gordon (15.8).

case.label: What it is
case.body: The 15.8-point hole is closed. What is left is a 1.8-point coin flip — the first Do-first card.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Montgomery practising fully by Friday would cut Marks further; nothing makes Marks the projection's pick.

whatWentWrong.title: IPADE priority was spent on a streaming defence
whatWentWrong.lead: Rams D/ST claimed at 02:46 CDMX for the Jaguars D/ST. Priority never resets in IPADE; STRATEGY §4 says never on a streamer.

case.label: What it cost
case.body: Rams 8.7 against the Jaguars' 7.0 this week, against Arizona's rookie Carson Beck. The Rams' bye is Week 11, so the seat turns over again next week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The Jaguars D/ST outscoring the Rams in Week 10 (archive) closes the reconstructed thesis WRONG.
